$comment: Port allocation, fixed by the project owner. Backend range is 3090 to 3099, frontend range is 4090 to 4099. Container-internal ports match host ports one to one, so there is one number per service and nothing to translate. Taking a new port means updating this file, .env.example, docker-compose.yml and the table in .claude/guardrails/ports-and-networking.md together.

services.name: cbd-db
services.note: Not 5432. A native PostgreSQL service already holds 5432 on the development machine, verified 2026-08-06.

services.name: cbd-gateway
services.note: The only port the browser needs for data. Everything else routes through it.

services.name: cbd-api
services.note: FastAPI. Exposed on the host for debugging and the OpenAPI docs at /docs.

services.name: cbd-tiles
services.note: pg_tileserv, MVT from PostGIS functions. Moved off its 7800 default via TS_HTTPPORT.

services.name: cbd-raster
services.note: TiTiler over COG files in /data/cog. Moved off its 8000 default via PORT.

services.name: cbd-web
services.note: Vite dev server. Listens on 0.0.0.0 with allowedHosts enabled so any LAN address works.

services.name: cbd-web-prod
services.note: nginx serving the production build, listening on 4091 rather than 80. Optional compose profile.
